desc: Derive the reduced row/column parity DSU formulation and the 2^(components) answer.
Implement the complete Python program for the reduced row/column parity DSU approach (fast I/O, iterative XOR-potential DSU, row/column parity checks, component count, modulo output).
Verify correctness on the sample tests and small random brute-force enumerations of tile orientations for tiny grids.
Ensure performance and memory for sum HW <= 1e6 and T <= 1e5.
